title: Former Rams great Marshall Faulk shares Parkinson's diagnosis, hopes to help others

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Former Rams great Marshall Faulk shares Parkinson's diagnosis, hopes to help others
sources.description: Marshall Faulk, the Hall of Fame running back and former Rams star, says he was diagnosed with Parkinson's about 18 months ago after noticing hand rigidity while golfing.
